goal.objective: Bind local source generation to an explicitly ACTIVATED StegCore Admissible-Existence capability and emit exact owner source packets for the existing owner-mutation executor without creating credential, policy, merge, or release authority.
success_predicates: Source-generation capability identity is explicit and current
Capability phase is ACTIVATED with integration evidence and activation proof
Local model/runtime proof is bound to the same execution
Execution lifetime is ONE_SHOT_OPERATION or SHORT_LIVED_WORKER
Teardown or reconstruction evidence is present
Generated files bind exact owner work/base/path/source hashes
No non-TV/TVC credential or token reaches the worker
Exact owner source packet is emitted for SHWP-FORMALISM-OWNER-MUTATION-EXECUTOR-001
failure_predicates: Capability authority is inferred from model/worker/heartbeat availability
Activation proof or integration evidence is missing
Persistent execution is assumed without separately admitted justification
Generated paths exceed admitted owner work
A GitHub/provider/wallet/TVC secret is consumed by the worker
Canonical AE or StegGate semantics are redefined

task.derivation_reason: Owner-mutation execution requires a separate, explicitly admitted source-generation capability rather than inferred model/worker authority.

activation.recheck_trigger: each control-plane observation while admitted owner work lacks an exact source packet and activation evidence may have advanced

completion.next_authorized_action: Validate explicit ACTIVATED capability evidence and a bounded local generation result; emit an exact source packet for the existing owner-mutation executor.
terminal_when: Every actionable admitted owner delta has either an exact source packet or a fail-closed machine-observable blocker
